1973.notes: 1.25% on residents and on nonresidents' Wilmington earnings: ACIR Significant Features 1973-74 ed. (M-79), Table 150 p. 291, rate at July 1, 1973. 59 Del. Laws c. 121 (1973) cut the statutory cap (22 Del. C. sec. 902) from 1.5% to 1.25%, where it has stayed; the city code (sec. 44-107, derived from the 1968 Code sec. 30-30) fixes the rate at 1 1/4%. Earlier years are not recorded: ACIR describes the 1969-1972 tax as a stepped rate on total income (none up to $4,000, 1/4% from $4,000 to $6,000, then 1/2% in 1969-70 and 1.5% from 1971), which the format cannot express.

1974.notes: 1.25%: ACIR lists Wilmington at 1.25% at July 1, 1973 and July 1, 1976, the statutory maximum under 22 Del. C. sec. 902 since 59 Del. Laws c. 121 (1973), whose history shows no later change to the cap; the rate is carried across 1974-1975. 1977-1982 are not recorded because the ACIR 1979-80 edition lists Wilmington at 1.0% at October 1, 1979, which no city document confirms or dates.

1975.notes: 1.25%: ACIR lists Wilmington at 1.25% at July 1, 1973 and July 1, 1976, the statutory maximum under 22 Del. C. sec. 902 since 59 Del. Laws c. 121 (1973), whose history shows no later change to the cap; the rate is carried across 1974-1975. 1977-1982 are not recorded because the ACIR 1979-80 edition lists Wilmington at 1.0% at October 1, 1979, which no city document confirms or dates.

1976.notes: 1.25%: ACIR Significant Features 1976-77 ed. vol. 2, Table 116 p. 225, rate at July 1, 1976 (statutory cap 1.25% under 22 Del. C. sec. 902 since 1973).

1983.notes: 1.25% on wages, residents and nonresidents deriving income from the city: ACIR Significant Features of Fiscal Federalism 1982-83 ed., Table 57 (p. 88), use of local income and wage taxes as of October 1983, Delaware municipal: rate employed 1.25%, limit 1.25%, one jurisdiction (Wilmington is Delaware's only city with a wage tax). Rate capped at 1.25% by 22 Del. C. section 902 (59 Del. Laws c. 121, 1973).

1984.notes: 1.25%, wages only: ACIR Significant Features of Fiscal Federalism 1984 ed., Table 56 (p. 84), 1984 local income tax rate for selected large cities, Wilmington (New Castle). Rate capped at 1.25% by 22 Del. C. section 902 (59 Del. Laws c. 121, 1973).

1985.notes: 1.25%, wages only: ACIR Significant Features of Fiscal Federalism 1985-86 ed., Table 59 (p. 89), 1985 local income tax rate for selected large cities, Wilmington. Rate capped at 1.25% by 22 Del. C. section 902 (59 Del. Laws c. 121, 1973).

1986.notes: 1.25% on residents and nonresidents: ACIR Significant Features 1987 ed., Table 56 p. 84, rates for 1986 (CCH December 1986).

1987.notes: 1.25% on residents and nonresidents: ACIR Significant Features 1988 ed., Table 20 p. 48, rates for 1987.

1988.notes: 1.25% on residents and nonresidents: ACIR Significant Features 1989 ed., Table 23 p. 48, rates for 1988.

1989.notes: 1.25% on residents and nonresidents: ACIR Significant Features 1990 ed., Table 21 p. 58, rates for 1989.

1990.notes: 1.25%: ACIR lists Wilmington at 1.25% for 1989 (1990 ed.) and at November 1991 (1992 ed., Table 24 p. 74); the 1991 edition has no city rate table, so 1990 is carried across.

1991.notes: 1.25% on residents and nonresidents: ACIR Significant Features 1992 ed., Table 24 p. 74, rates at November 1991.

1992.notes: 1.25% on residents and nonresidents: ACIR Significant Features 1993 ed., Table 24 p. 78, rates at November 1992.

1994.notes: 1.25% on residents and nonresidents: ACIR Significant Features 1995 ed., Table 21 p. 71, rates at November 1994.

2003.notes: 1.25%: City of Wilmington Department of Finance, Earned Income Tax Regulations (April 2003 edition), Article II, Sections 201-202: tax on residents' and nonresidents' salaries, wages and other compensation, and on net profits, at one and one quarter percent (1.25%). The city's Multi-Year Financial Forecast FY2003-2007 (March 2003, https://web.archive.org/web/20040625061759/http://www.ci.wilmington.de.us:80/pdf/financialreport.pdf, list of major city taxes) also gives the wage/earnings tax as 1.25%. Rate capped at 1.25% by 22 Del. C. section 902.
